name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded a Next.js app (`my-copilot-app`) and installed the CopilotKit packages (`@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`), with npm confirming "added 1166 packages, and audited 1532 packages." However, I was blocked from completing the quickstart because no API keys—neither `OPENAI_API_KEY` nor `CPK_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY`—were present in the sandbox environment, despite the instructions stating credentials were already exported. Additionally, I could not fetch the full quickstart documentation from `docs.copilotkit.ai` due to TLS connection resets and HTTP 403 restrictions, so I lacked the complete, up-to-date code examples needed to wire up the runtime route and provider.
